user.title: Create your household
user.description: Create a program in the Occupied panel, import a YAML snapshot, or select an authoritative managed file. Permission starts disabled.

proof.title: Original caller proof
proof.description: Configure the milestone-one deterministic sequence. Permission starts disabled. Leave the activation entity empty for manual control. Each activation gradually brings the selected light to the configured brightness, then runs the light pair and optional remote activity.

yaml.title: Import Occupied YAML
yaml.description: Import a snapshot of your Occupied program. The source file is not watched or modified.

file.title: Use a managed file
file.description: Choose YAML under the Home Assistant config directory. The file remains authoritative and read only; changes are detected automatically.

error.invalid_config: Check the selected entities, allowed states, activity name, and duration bounds.
error.invalid_program: The YAML is not a valid Occupied program. Validate it with the Occupied CLI to see field and line details.
error.invalid_file: Cannot load this file. Check the relative path, read permissions, and Occupied YAML; use the CLI for detailed validation.

abort.already_configured: One Occupied household is already configured.
abort.invalid_program: The canonical Occupied program is invalid.
abort.single_instance_allowed: One Occupied household is already configured.

init.title: Occupied caller proof
init.description: Configure the milestone-one deterministic sequence. Permission starts disabled. Leave the activation entity empty for manual control. Each activation gradually brings the selected light to the configured brightness, then runs the light pair and optional remote activity.

error.invalid_config: Check the selected entities, allowed states, activity name, and duration bounds.

abort.daily_program: Edit this household from Occupied under Settings > Devices & services.

managed_file.title: Occupied managed configuration could not be loaded

source_conflict.title: Occupied bootstrap conflicts with the existing household
source_conflict.description: configuration.yaml selects a different source from the existing Occupied entry. Choose the source explicitly in Occupied → Configuration, or remove the bootstrap declaration. Occupied has kept the existing source.
